statusHistory.note: Operator request (chat, 2026-09-21): second Salvador pin, gastronomic. Dona Mariquita is a 15-year-old (opened ~2011) heritage-cuisine restaurant in Rio Vermelho run by chef Leila Carreiro, researching and reviving indigenous/African/sertanejo Bahian recipes largely erased from restaurant menus. Well-covered by real press — CNN Brasil V&G, an Alô Alô Bahia column, and named among Bahia Notícias's six Afrocentric-menu restaurants for Consciência Negra — a genuine editorial pattern, not a single lucky mention. Google Maps verified live (4.5 stars, 1,481 reviews, R$80-180/person, R. do Meio 178, Rio Vermelho — same street as SAN's original candidate pick Discodelia, but a different, unrelated address/venue, confirmed via check-duplicates.mjs with no proximity flag). Reviews read directly: consistently high praise for the moqueca/poqueca and Arroz de Hauçá, with practical notes (farofa isn't automatic with the moqueca, must be ordered separately). Instagram (@donamariquita, 70.3K followers) confirms address and hours (daily noon-5pm) and supplied the hero photo (a real portrait of chef Leila Carreiro, not AI-generated, per operator direction). No genuine standing dated event found for this piece; none forced. Single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive.
